units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905

zones.comment: the start island's trigger (sound and fade), around the destination `tele_` the spawn teleports everybody to
the last island, round the trigger that plays the ending song (24 x 24 units, too small to be crossed reliably on its own)

author: Tony Montana (tmontana)
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own logic (gb-maps-2). The 64 team spawns stand on a teleport (unfiltered, under the spawn floor) to `tele_`, the start island, inside the one trigger_multiple that plays the map's opening sound and fades in; that trigger is the start line. Eight sections follow, tele_1..tele_8, each with an unfiltered water pit and a block pit behind `bhopfilter` (a name the block triggers give the player 0.09 s after they land: the anti-standing trap, imported as sinking blocks). Past tele_8's section the route ends on an island walled by four tall trigger_pushes, where a 24-unit trigger plays the ending song; the finish is a box round it. Not published.
